study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Xiao et al., Biological Psychiatry: Global Open Science, 2025
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Deviations From Normative Functioning Underlying Emotional Episodic Memory Revealed Cross-Scale Neurodiverse Alterations Linked to Affective Symptoms in Distinct Psychiatric Disorders

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: The study used Gaussian process regression (GPR) to estimate normative models for functional activation underlying emotional episodic memory. The implementation was done using the Predictive Clinical Neuroscience (PCN) toolkit (https://pcntoolkit.readthedocs.io).
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: We utilized Gaussian process regression to estimate normative models reflecting relevant functional activation underlying emotional episodic memory using the Predictive Clinical Neuroscience toolkit (https://pcntoolkit.readthedocs.io/en/ latest).
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Xiao2024.pdf.md: Methods and Materials / Normative Modeling and Estimating Individual Deviations

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: The response variable was task-fMRI functional activation maps derived from the 'aversive-neutral' contrast during the retrieval phase of an emotional episodic memory task. Regional activation values were extracted from 68 cortical and 14 subcortical regions defined by the Desikan-Killiany (DK) atlas.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: For each participant, a general linear model was used to identify functions activated by the task of each brain region defined by the Desikan-Killiany (DK) atlas. The regressors were constructed from the rest, aversive, and neutral blocks, and we selected the 'aversive -neutral' activation maps in the retrieval phase as the effect induced by emotion.
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Xiao2024.pdf.md: Methods and Materials / Functional Activation Analysis

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Explanatory variables consisted of task performances: reaction time (RT) during encoding phase, RT during retrieval phase, and accuracy (ACC) during retrieval phase. Age and sex were not included in the main normative model but were evaluated in sensitivity analyses.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: First, the task activation maps were used as response variables, and predictive factors comprised task performances including RT in the encoding and retrieval phase and ACC in the retrieval phase.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.location: Xiao2024.pdf.md: Methods and Materials / Normative Modeling and Estimating Individual Deviations
